test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Aman drives 5 km from point A towards the south. He then takes a left turn and drives 5 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km. He again takes a right turn and drives 10 km. He finally takes a right turn and drives 10 km to reach point B. How much and in which direction does he have to drive to return to point A? (All the turns are 90° turns only.)
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Aman drives 5 km from point A towards the south.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f8b8c5b7d939f3bd991e5fbef39678ae02019066a4ea9f706071ad2d9d0c6a1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6e71209304983879cfe1deca36659dd03104b2d61326a1096ce8a69b2caf474.png] 

2) He then takes a left turn and drives 5 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0a11b1eb6c32466d42f0e26c31b9564bcfb45a73ecaf7034bbc235d7ca5c1d7.png] 

3) He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f09432dfc7ce3fc00e87b291d0c91f7593024d86ccf706a753d9b85ddb16016.png] 

4) He again takes a right turn and drives 10 km. He finally takes a right turn and drives 10 km to reach point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02a10490d73147c6095a528b9cf72a6590dfae20611b347a2c79bfc47a1adc37.png] 

Here, we can see that he needs to drive 5 km towards the east to return to point A.

Hence, the correct answer is** "5 km towards the east"**.
